coverageNotes: Part I only. Source-bounded coverage, not a guarantee that every optional scene has been discovered.
Chapter indicates first documented availability; use each note’s calendar window and deadline. Linked conversations are grouped into ordered steps.
Sourced means guide-documented, not independently verified in play. Two conflicting date windows are labeled uncertain; exact expiry times are stated only where documented.
